meta.identity_evidence: visual portrait bridge (>=75% agreement) + external cast list
meta.anonymisation: show titles, character names, voice-actor names and external character ids are replaced by opaque identifiers. Clip UUIDs are the Anim-400K identifiers and are not anonymised, since they are what a licensed user joins against; a licensed user can therefore recover the titles and names from the corpus itself, while an unlicensed reader cannot.

conditions.MONO: same character, same language, different episodes
conditions.MONO_EN: same character, English side; pooled with MONO to form the Mono condition
conditions.MONO_VA: different characters sharing the Japanese voice actor; impostors only, scored against the pooled Mono positives
conditions.XLING: same character, Japanese original vs English dub
conditions.XLING_K: four-clip bundle vs bundle, impostor unconstrained
conditions.XLING_KP: four-clip bundle vs bundle, impostor matched on measured pitch
conditions.retrieval: Japanese bundle queried against a 53-way English gallery

meta.pooling: the Mono condition is MONO and MONO_EN scored together

trial_sampling.draw: a single seeded random draw, frozen and shipped as-is; clips are drawn with replacement, so a pair can occur more than once in a condition

pitch_matching.f0: librosa.pyin fmin=65 fmax=500 hop=256, per-0.5s-window median, identity = median over its clips

meta.loader: mono 16 kHz, fixed 10 s (160k samples): longer clips truncated, shorter ones zero-padded, so every clip is handed to a system at the same length
meta.spans: two_speaker_repair.json records the 95 clips found to hold a turn exchange, with the segment the audit kept. The loader does not apply them; they are provenance
meta.clip_list_note: the released clip list holds 1,616 files; 40 English clips are released but referenced by no trial, because the lists were frozen before those clips were restored
meta.splits_note: anim400k_splits records which official Anim-400K splits an identity draws from, for anyone needing disjointness from their training data
